remaining_external_issue.message: Publisher misconfiguration: no form(s) configured for input app ID ca-app-pub-7806638519709442~4983717950
remaining_external_issue.effect: All eligible profiles fail closed and do not initialize/load AdMob. Gameplay remains available.
remaining_external_issue.required_action: Configure and publish appropriate AdMob Privacy & messaging forms; keep automatic Analytics consent propagation disabled because app uses separate adult opt-in. Rerun eligible native ad-flow after server configuration. Do not bypass consent errors.

limitations: Observed one signed release on Android36 emulator, not every supported Android version/physical device/jurisdiction.
UID counters do not attribute Google Play services shared-process traffic. Zero UID traffic plus no native startup/artifacts/logs is bounded evidence, not universal certification.
No native loaded-ad behavior could be verified due UMP publisher configuration; request policy is covered by Unity tests.
Withdrawal leaves previously created Firebase/FID/cache files; it disables further app collection, not remote deletion. In-flight/already sent data is not retroactively cancelled.
No iOS SDK runtime claim from these Android tests.
Age treatment may be transmitted for eligible teens, although exact selected band/DOB is not a game Analytics property.
